'''Endrodanar Tiopuld Shaamador Vandelhelm XXIV''', commonly known as '''Endro''', and his older sister [[Lillindri Nanimei Filda Vandelhelm XXXII]] were the [[Venerated Ones]] of [[Vandelhelm/Legends|Vandelhelm]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The last descendants of Vandelhelm's founding dynasty and a living symbol of Vandelhelm's metalsmithing industry, Endro and his sister held tremendous importance to the [[Planet/Legends|world's]] [[Metalsmiths Guild]], and were [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for three years in order to exert greater control over the smiths. Endro and Lilli were returned home by the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], and [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]] a now-teenage Endro launched his own failed attempt to overthrow his sister as [[Guild Master/Legends|Guildmaster]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Hey, you two weren't bad... for a couple of brats.|Han Solo|<ref name="SW98" />}}
Endrodanar Tiopuld Shaamador Vandelhelm XXIV&mdash;commonly known as "Endro" for short&mdash;was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] native of [[Vandelhelm/Legends|Vandelhelm]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] renowned for its high-quality metals, alloys and shipbuilding capacity. Endro and his sister [[Lillindri Nanimei Filda Vandelhelm XXXII]], or "Lilli," were the last two living members of the Vandelhelm dynasty, descending from the two families who discovered the ore-rich world and developed the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] and smelting techniques that earned Vandelhelm a place of importance in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] commerce. Their lineage earned them the name "[[Venerated Ones]]" during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Although not technically royals, their descent made them extremely important to the planet's [[Metalsmiths Guild]], who saw them as a symbol of their industry.<ref name="SW98" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-aligned [[Guild Master/Legends|Guildmaster]] [[Orrk]] conspired to have Endro and Lilli arrested and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] in an internment facility on [[Ord Vaug]], in order to exert greater control over the metalsmiths' production. After three years in Imperial custody, the Venerated Ones were finally [[Liberation of Ord Vaug|rescued]] by the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="VEaA" /> At the time, Endro was still a small child, sticking by his older sister's side as Alliance heroes [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb]] personally [[Mission to Vandelhelm|escorted]] the Venerated Ones back to Vandelhelm in Solo's ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]''. Orrk and his Imperial ally, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mordur]], desperately tried to maintain control over Vandelhelm with an attempt on the siblings' lives, Solo and Lilli ended the threat by killing Orrk and his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] backup.<ref name="SW98" />

With Orrk out of the picture and Imperial influence gone from Vandelhelm, Lilli was named Guildmistress of the Metalsmiths Guild the day after Solo's departure, aged 15. Within a decade, Endro had become his sister's security advisor and spokesperson despite his young age, during a period where Lilli's control over the Metalsmiths Guild faced a number of challenges from within and without. As it happened, Endro promised to be one of those challenges, as the younger brother had his eye on his sister's position. In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], Vandelhelm hosted a ceremony to honor the 10th anniversary of the Venerated Ones' return to their homeworld, attended by Solo and Nunb among others. As a celebration of a decade of alliance between Vandelhelm and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Vandelhelm's shipwrights and metalsmiths constructed a "Solo fleet" of [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] stocked with valuable metals and treasures, bound for the New Republic-held [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]].<ref name="VEaA" />

Endro planned to use a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] he had modified to serve as Lilli's bodyguard to attack and kill her and Solo during the ceremony, hoping to pin the murders on Nunb, whom he would accuse of sabotaging the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] in the name of "[[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] rights." From there, he would take sole control over the guild, and sell the "Solo fleet" to the highest bidder. However, it was Nunb who foiled the plot, reacting in time to neutralize the droid before it could fix its target. Realizing that Endro was behind the attempted [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]], Solo attacked the younger Venerated One, and while Endro got in a couple solid hits, he suffered a brutal beating at the hands of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] war hero.<ref name="VEaA" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I could have told them the kid was trouble, if anyone had asked. The kid hadn't looked me in the eye since we landed, but he could hardly stop himself from glancing at that droid every minute.|Nien Nunb|<ref name="VEaA" />}}
Endro displayed a high capacity for treachery by a relatively young age, attempting to overthrow his sister and seize power while still a teenager. However, his furtiveness and antisocial nature betrayed him, attracting suspicion before the critical moment. Endro showed a preternatural affinity for technology despite his youth, having a deep knowledge of all of Vandelhelm's security systems and even modifying a protocol droid to serve as his sister's bodyguard.<ref name="VEaA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Endro appeared for the first time in [[Star Wars (1977) 98|''Star Wars'' (1977) 98]], written by [[Archie Goodwin]], illustrated by [[Al Williamson]] and released in [[1985]].<ref name="SW98" /> His full name was later given in the [[2004]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] article ''[[Vandelhelm: Enemies and Alloys]]'', written by [[Cory J. Herndon]].<ref name="VEaA" />
